answer: Rape under Section 63 includes acts without consent, acts involving minors, and manipulation causing penetration.
summary_answer: Rape under Section 63 involves sexual acts without consent, with or without consent if the victim is under eighteen, and includes manipulation causing penetration.
detailed_answer: Rape is defined under Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, as involving acts done without the consent of a woman (Section 63(d)(ii)). It also includes acts performed with or without consent when the woman is under eighteen years of age (Section 63(v)(vi)). Additionally, it encompasses the manipulation of any part of a woman's body to cause penetration into her vagina, urethra, anus, or any part of her body, or making her do so with him or any other person (Section 63(c)).
final_answer: Rape under Section 63 includes acts without consent, acts involving minors, and manipulation causing penetration.
